newsitem.title: USA: Chattem sees 97 EPS 60 pct higher than 96.
newsitem.headline: Chattem sees 97 EPS 60 pct higher than 96.

text.p: Chattem Inc said Thursday it expected its fiscal 1997 earnings per share to jump 60 percent over last year, based on the results for the first six months ended May 31.

Chattem posted net earnings of $0.40 per share in its 1996 fiscal year ended November 30. Based on its projected 60 percent increase, the company expects earnings per share of around $0.64 for the current fiscal year ending November 30.
The company also expected sales to increase 20 percent over the $118.9 million it achieved in 1996.

Chattem also reiterated its planned acquisition of Sunsource International Inc should add $0.20 to $0.30 per share in fiscal 1998. The company announced the merger May 23 and expects to close the deal at the end of this month.

Chattem said it expected the acquisition to add $25 million in annual sales, bringing the company within 10 percent to 15 percent of its goal of achieving $200 million in annual sales. The acquisition will not materially add to the company's 1997 earnings, it added.
Chattem's stock traded at a yearly high of 13 in the early afternoon, up 3/8 from Wednesday.
